summary: Sable Offshore Corp. filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of $345M aggregate principal amount of 6.5% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, with an additional $45M issued pursuant to an over-allotment option. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, mature July 1, 2031, and interest is payable semiannually. Conversion is permissible only upon specified events before April 1, 2031, and at any time thereafter. Settlement may be in cash, shares, or a combination at the company's election. This is a routine financing transaction; no special situation such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing discloses material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation creation.
